## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-body);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,monospace` |
